teaser: What happens when a path meant for solitude meets four letters built to keep the structure standing? You carry life path 7, the seeker, and you test as ISTJ, steady and exact. At a campsite at night, after everyone else has gone quiet in their tents, you are still awake, checking that the fire has gone down right, turning a question over that nobody else at the campsite would think to ask. Quiet to think in is the first order of this life path; the fire checked properly before anyone sleeps is the first order of these four letters. In you those two errands are, most nights, the same walk around the same small clearing.
